title: Two Cans
logline: Same architect, same Monday, stacked in split screen: on top she runs on a sticky sugary can, below she runs on {product}. By 3pm only one of them is still sharp, and the other one knows it.

world.setting: The fictional Brooks Studio, a small architecture practice in a converted warehouse in Chicago, one Monday from 9am to 6pm. The same woman lives the day twice: the sugar way (top pane) and the sugarfree way (bottom pane).
world.palette: Bottom pane built from the can: cool daylight, sky blue, brushed silver, white foam models. Top pane: warm tungsten, dull beige and candy pink, crumbs and clutter.
fictional_brands: Brooks Studio (her practice, never shown as text)
the rival: a plain candy-pink can with no label, no text and no logo, standing for any generic sugary drink
world.rules: No real competitor, no rival branding at all. Walls, screens, drawings and clocks are blank; every time stamp, pane label and divider is added in post.

consumable.moment: both versions refill from their pack at 9am; the old pack is empty or messy by 3pm

beats.summary: Split screen, both panes in sync: the same woman cracks a can at 9am. Top: sticky pink spray. Bottom: a clean crack, she looks at us.
Ping-pong: 11am top, fingers stuck to the keyboard; 11am bottom, fast clean sketching; 3pm top, a giant yawn at the meeting table.
3pm bottom: she presents the model, sharp and fast.
The split collapses, the sugarfree side takes the frame: the can at chest height, the brand line.
The sugar-way Nia looks straight at her other self, concedes, and bins the pink can.
The can standing on the finished model at golden hour, tagline.

music.brief: One motif in two versions, 100 bpm: a detuned, wobbly, slightly flat Rhodes and lazy kick for the sugar pane; the same motif bright and tight on plucked synth and clean claps for the sugarfree pane; the edit switches versions on each ping-pong cut.
Bright version only, filtered down under the product line, a comic one-beat dropout for Okay. Fine.
Bright version opens up with a warm pad and resolves on the tonic under the tagline.
